# opnsense_haproxy_frontend_actions (Resource)

The ordered rule list (`linkedActions`) of an existing HAProxy frontend. This resource owns only that list: the frontend itself, with its listen addresses, certificates and other settings, stays managed elsewhere. The list is authoritative, so every rule the frontend should run must be listed, including rules other tools add (the ACME client plugin appends its `redirect_acme_challenges` rule if it is missing). Destroying this resource empties the frontend's rule list. Requires the `os-haproxy` plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The frontend itself is managed outside Terraform; only its rule list is set here.
# The web rule runs before the ACME client plugin's challenge rule. That rule stays
# in the list, otherwise the plugin appends it again and the next plan shows a diff.
resource "opnsense_haproxy_frontend_actions" "http" {
  frontend_id = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" # UUID of the port-80 frontend
  action_ids = [
    opnsense_haproxy_action.web_acme.id,
    "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002", # UUID of redirect_acme_challenges
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action_ids` (List of String) UUIDs of the rules (`opnsense_haproxy_action`) in evaluation order. HAProxy uses the first `use_backend` rule that matches.
- `frontend_id` (String) UUID of the frontend (OPNsense: Public Service) whose rules are managed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `frontend_id`.
